name: monitor-walkthrough
label: Synthetic demo
alt: AutoPipeline's monitor on the synthetic demo: a live run lights up each stage on the rail and timeline, then captioned steps show a stage's record, the traced surfaces with 3D wireframes, the stand-in ink map in a dark-to-pale copper scale beside its reversed control on the same scale, log filters and the tool log, notes, a console command running as a job with its output, the VC3D quick actions, the run's files, and the light and dark themes.
caption: Synthetic demo: AutoPipeline's monitor following scripts/demo_synthetic.py, each stage held 1.2 s so the run can be watched, then a captioned walk through its panels and console. Stroke shapes were planted in the synthetic CT and a stand-in ink model scores them, so its maps are not ink; the reversed control shows only the synthetic papyrus.
sources: scripts/demo_synthetic.py of AutoPipeline 0.1.7 (synthetic CT with planted strokes)
